## Data Entities

- [[Wiki/Data Entities/Audit Trail|Audit Trail]] — A record of evidence and agent reasoning accompanying KYC decisions for regulatory review.
- [[Wiki/Data Entities/Confidence Score|Confidence Score]] — A numeric measure guiding automatic approval, additional verification, or escalation in KYC.
- [[Wiki/Data Entities/Fraud Alert|Fraud Alert]] — An outbound notification of suspicious activity sent to security teams and monitoring systems.
- [[Wiki/Data Entities/ID Verification Result|ID Verification Result]] — A response from third-party checks or internal validations confirming identity status.
- [[Wiki/Data Entities/Identity Document|Identity Document]] — A submitted document (e.g., passport, ID) used for OCR extraction and authenticity checks.
- [[Wiki/Data Entities/KYC Decision|KYC Decision]] — An outbound decision record including approval state, confidence, and supporting audit context.
- [[Wiki/Data Entities/KYC Request|KYC Request]] — An inbound event representing a new customer application initiating KYC processing.
- [[Wiki/Data Entities/Risk Score|Risk Score]] — A dynamic, explainable measure of customer risk maintained and shared across systems.
- [[Wiki/Data Entities/Transaction Event|Transaction Event]] — An event containing fraud or risk signals associated with a customer profile.

## Logical Application Components

- [[Wiki/Logical Application Components/Case Management System|Case Management System]] — A system receiving escalated KYC cases with agent analysis to support human review.
- [[Wiki/Logical Application Components/Compliance & Risk Sub-Agent|Compliance & Risk Sub-Agent]] — An application component that interprets jurisdictional KYC rules, drives validations, and generates attestations.
- [[Wiki/Logical Application Components/Core Banking System|Core Banking System]] — A system triggered to activate accounts after approved KYC validation.
- [[Wiki/Logical Application Components/Customer Experience Sub-Agent|Customer Experience Sub-Agent]] — An application component that reduces onboarding friction and recommends actions to lower abandonment and improve upsell.
- [[Wiki/Logical Application Components/Customer Management System|Customer Management System]] — An enterprise system receiving real-time KYC decisions to update verification and activation status.
- [[Wiki/Logical Application Components/Document Analysis Sub-Agent|Document Analysis Sub-Agent]] — An application component that extracts data via OCR, handles poor images and languages, and detects document forgery.
- [[Wiki/Logical Application Components/Event Listeners|Event Listeners]] — Listener components that filter and normalize inbound events and prepare documents for downstream processing.
- [[Wiki/Logical Application Components/Fraud Detection Sub-Agent|Fraud Detection Sub-Agent]] — An application component that detects suspicious behavior, correlates with history, and maintains explainable risk scores.
- [[Wiki/Logical Application Components/Identity Verification Sub-Agent|Identity Verification Sub-Agent]] — An application component that validates identities against watchlists and vendor checks using NLP for name variations.
- [[Wiki/Logical Application Components/KYC Knowledge Base|KYC Knowledge Base]] — A retrieval-augmented repository integrating regulations, policies, and vendor docs to ground agent decisions.
- [[Wiki/Logical Application Components/KYC Orchestration Supervisor Agent|KYC Orchestration Supervisor Agent]] — A coordinating application component that routes work and manages confidence-driven decisions across KYC sub-agents.
- [[Wiki/Logical Application Components/Real-Time Decision Store|Real-Time Decision Store]] — A low-latency store for current KYC status, risk scores, histories, and dynamic configuration.
- [[Wiki/Logical Application Components/Risk And AML System|Risk And AML System]] — A bidirectionally integrated system maintaining consistent risk assessments during KYC.
- [[Wiki/Logical Application Components/Transaction Monitoring System|Transaction Monitoring System]] — A system ingesting fraud alerts and risk scores to act on suspicious patterns.

## Physical Technology Components

- [[Wiki/Physical Technology Components/AWS CloudTrail|AWS CloudTrail]] — An auditing service used to log API calls for compliance and regulatory requirements.
- [[Wiki/Physical Technology Components/AWS Direct Connect|AWS Direct Connect]] — A dedicated network service providing encrypted connectivity to on‑premises financial systems.
- [[Wiki/Physical Technology Components/AWS Lambda|AWS Lambda]] — A serverless compute service used to integrate MSK with AgentCore and publish results asynchronously.
- [[Wiki/Physical Technology Components/AWS Site-to-Site VPN|AWS Site-to-Site VPN]] — A managed VPN service enabling encrypted connectivity between AWS and on‑premises networks.
- [[Wiki/Physical Technology Components/AgentCore Gateway|AgentCore Gateway]] — An AgentCore integration component using OpenAPI to manage auth, validation, and retries for tool calls.
- [[Wiki/Physical Technology Components/AgentCore Identity|AgentCore Identity]] — An AgentCore component managing authentication and authorization for agents and tool access.
- [[Wiki/Physical Technology Components/AgentCore Memory|AgentCore Memory]] — A built-in AgentCore feature providing shared, persistent session context to collaborating agents.
- [[Wiki/Physical Technology Components/AgentCore Runtime Environment|AgentCore Runtime Environment]] — The AgentCore execution environment offering orchestration, session state, and memory persistence for agents.
- [[Wiki/Physical Technology Components/Amazon Bedrock AgentCore|Amazon Bedrock AgentCore]] — A managed agent runtime providing orchestration, state, memory, and tool integrations for KYC agents.
- [[Wiki/Physical Technology Components/Amazon Bedrock|Amazon Bedrock]] — A managed foundation model platform used for document analysis, risk assessment, and agentic orchestration.
- [[Wiki/Physical Technology Components/Amazon CloudWatch|Amazon CloudWatch]] — A monitoring service used alongside audit logging to observe system behavior and events.
- [[Wiki/Physical Technology Components/Amazon DynamoDB|Amazon DynamoDB]] — A managed NoSQL database implementing the Real-Time Decision Store for low-latency access to KYC data.
- [[Wiki/Physical Technology Components/Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK)|Amazon Managed Streaming for Apache Kafka (Amazon MSK)]] — A managed Kafka service providing the streaming backbone for real-time KYC event exchange.
- [[Wiki/Physical Technology Components/Amazon OpenSearch Serverless|Amazon OpenSearch Serverless]] — A managed search service providing vector-based semantic retrieval for the KYC Knowledge Base.
- [[Wiki/Physical Technology Components/Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3)|Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3)]] — Object storage used to hold regulations, policies, and vendor documents feeding the KYC Knowledge Base.
